text:
Lena: Quick sync on the benchmark launch assets — want a compact \"hero\" we can use across LinkedIn, a webinar slide, and an interactive micro-calculator. Timeline: soft-launch next Tues. Who owns what?
Marco: I can re-run the benchmark slices and output p50/p95 and $/1k tokens for hosted/dedicated/private. Which model family should be the hero?
Lena: Use the family that best illustrates the tradeoff (latency vs cost) from our last run, but show one cheaper quantized variant as a separate series. Hero seq = 256.
Jess: Audience: devs + platform. For paid social, short hooks only. For webinar - deeper messaging about predictable spend and fallbacks. Suggest 2 CTAs on landing: \"Try API\" and \"Request capacity consult\".
Kai: Hero visual idea: horizontal band chart overlaying cost bands + a scatter of p95 latency points. Keep copy minimal: headline + 2 bullets. I'll mock 1200x628 and 800x800.
Rohit: Add a tiny product note on routing: show how smart routing can drop p95 during spikes by routing non-critical traffic to a cheaper variant. Ops teams like concrete examples.
Marco: Data note: quantization reduces cost but sometimes increases p95 tail. I'll create dashed lines for quantized cost and a small table with raw numbers for transparency.
Lena: Copy candidates — please vote: 1) \"Latency you can count on. Costs you can predict.\" 2) \"Serve fast without surprise bills.\" 3) \"Optimize p95, reduce per-token spend.\"
Jess: I prefer 1 for enterprise landing, 2 for social ad. Keep CTAs short.
Kai: Design constraint: no tiny text on social images. If we need footnotes, place them on the landing or slide, not the image.
Marco: Deliverables: CSV+JSON of raw numbers by tomorrow AM, a summary table for the asset. I'll include per-embedding cost too in case we call out embeddings.
Rohit: Webinar outline: 1) Why latency economics matter (5m) 2) Demo: routing + fallback (10m) 3) Bench walkthrough + reading the charts (10m) 4) Customer vignette (5m) 5) Q&A (10m). Keep total under 40m.
Lena: Good. Also want a tiny interactive calculator on the landing that takes seq length and tps and returns estimated $/month. Marco, can you provide numbers?
Marco: Yes, will give a compact JSON schema for the calc. Use conservative assumptions and include a note \"based on benchmark configs\".
Jess: Lead routing: ad clicks with utm_source=bench_social should go to landing; A/B test CTA prominence (Try API first vs Talk to Sales first). Track conversions separately for SMB vs Enterprise via hidden form field.
Kai: Visuals: palette: blue = hosted, orange = dedicated, slate = private. Also create a mono version for slides.
Lena: Legal check — avoid absolute percentage claims. If we say \"up to 40%\", flag the data source. Marco add footnote in assets.
Marco: Will annotate CSV with exact comparisons and include an \"up to\" qualifier where needed.
Rohit: For webinar follow-ups, segment attendees: demo request -> product squad, enterprise questions -> AE. Also prepare a short technical FAQ doc for attendees.
Jess: I'll draft email cadence: pre-1 (announce), pre-2 (reminder w/ hero chart), pre-3 (day-of). Post-1 (thanks + recording + calc link), Post-2 (nurture with consult CTA).
deploy-bot: Calendar event created: \"Bench Launch Review\" Wed 09:30.
Lena: Action items: @Marco export CSV/JSON + annotated numbers (tomorrow AM). @Kai mock hero + social variants (tomorrow noon). @Jess landing copy + email flows + utm plan (Wed EOD). @Rohit webinar deck + FAQ (Wed EOD). I'll assemble assets and schedule review Thurs morning.
Kai: Will use minimal text, big numbers, and a snapshot table for p50/p95.
Marco: Also adding a tiny table showing cost per 1k tokens at seq 64/256/1024 so folks can scale estimate.
Jess: We'll A/B test headline variant A vs B on paid channels for 2 days and route budget based on CTR.
Lena: Perfect. Flagged risk: any claim needing a benchmark context should have a link to the raw CSV on the landing. We'll host it as a downloadable asset.
Rohit: Agreed. Keep messaging clear: product reliability + predictable economics, not just \"cheapest.\"
Lena: Thanks all — expect the first drafts in the next 24 hours. Ping in-thread with any blockers. :rocket:
